items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: There is no fixed minimum order. We are built for regular supply of 500+ pallets per month, and full truckloads get the best price per piece. Tell us your monthly volume in the form and we will tailor the offer.

items.q: Are your pallets and collars new?
items.a: Yes — we sell only brand-new EPAL pallets and brand-new pallet collars, straight from production. We do not trade used, repaired or sorted pallets.
Items in stock usually leave our yard within 48 hours. Delivery time then depends on the destination — we confirm the exact date with your quote.

items.q: Do pallet collars fit every Euro pallet?
items.a: Our collars are made for the standard 1200 × 800 mm EPAL format and fit any pallet built to that standard.

items.q: Can we set up regular monthly deliveries?
items.a: Yes. Most customers order on a fixed monthly schedule. We agree volumes and delivery days with you and keep stock reserved for your orders.

cookies.text: We use necessary cookies to run this site. With your consent we would also like to use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used.

cookies.analyticsText: Anonymous statistics about visits. Off unless you allow it.

sections.p: WAV Invest is responsible for the personal data processed on this website. You can reach us at the contact details in the footer.

When you send the quote form we receive your name, company, email, phone number and the details of your request. We use them only to answer your request and prepare an offer (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The request is stored in our customer database, hosted in the EU (Supabase, Frankfurt), and we are notified by email (Resend). To protect the form from spam we use Cloudflare Turnstile, which checks that the form is sent by a person; it does not set advertising cookies. We keep the data for as long as needed for the business relationship and legal retention periods.

We set a necessary cookie to remember your language (NEXT_LOCALE) and one to remember your cookie choice (wav_consent). Analytics cookies are only set if you allow them, and you can change your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer.
You have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the processing of your data, to data portability and to object. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.
